dog.description_text:
Meet Davis, a cat with a curious mind and a love for taking in the world around him!

Davis enjoys observing the scene and keeping an eye on all the interesting things happening nearby. He's a thoughtful guy who likes to stay in the know!

Davis is also a big fan of yummy treats! A tasty snack is always a great way to brighten his day and make a new friend. He has a sweet charm about him and is ready to find someone to share all his little daily adventures with.

If you're looking for a handsome companion who enjoys people watching, tasty treats and discovering the world around him, Davis would love to meet you! Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
